title: campanopsis dalmatica
intro: Campanopsis dalmatica, commonly known as Dalmatian bellflower or Bellflower, is a species of flowering plant in the family Campanulaceae. This plant is traditionally used in medicine due to its reported health benefits, which include reducing inflammation and improving cardiovascular health. The therapeutic actions of Campanopsis dalmatica involve antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and vasodilatory properties. The bioactive constituents of the plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
